## History

Daniel Blair was visited by [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde during their canvassing efforts for the [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), following their interaction with the Andrew sisters. He was known to be perpetually strange and frequently threw fits during which he refused to leave his bed.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P48](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0048)_
